sv.title: Vem ringer Telias sista samtal?
sv.summary: Det har funnit i 150 år. Men sista november släcker Telia sitt nät – för alltid. Och du har chans att bli den som ringer sist av alla.

en.title: Who makes Telia's last call?
en.summary: It has existed for 150 years. But on the last day of November, Telia switches off its network – for good. And you have a chance to be the one who makes the last call of all.
